title: pi-voice-telegram companion settings
description: Per-agent companion settings for the pi-voice-telegram extension. Edit and restart the agent session for changes to take effect. See README.md for the canonical key reference; this schema is the machine-readable form. The companion extension lives at `~/.pi/agent/npm/node_modules/pi-voice-telegram/` and reads this file at `~/.pi/agent/pi-voice-telegram.json` on each session start.

_hint.description: Free-form hint string. Ignored by the extension. Use as a place for an at-a-glance reminder of where the docs are; the extension never reads this field, but humans and LLMs inspecting the file will see it.

inbound.description: Controls the inbound voice/audio echo pipeline (downloads voice notes, runs STT via whisper-server, sends a 🎙️ echo to the user, and feeds the transcript into the agent prompt).

echoEnabled.description: When false, skip the inbound echo + transcript-injection handlers entirely. The bridge still receives the voice message, but the agent never sees a transcript and the user never sees the 🎙️ confirmation. Set this to false to fully disable the deterministic inbound STT pipeline (e.g. if you only want the LLM-callable transcribe_audio tool to do STT on demand).

tools.description: Controls the LLM-callable tool surface. The bridge's `telegram_attach` and `telegram_message` are always available; the companion's `synthesize_voice` + `transcribe_audio` are gated on these flags.

enabled.description: Master switch for tool registration. When false, neither `synthesize_voice` nor `transcribe_audio` is registered, regardless of the per-tool flags below. When true, the per-tool flags decide which of the two are actually exposed.
Register the TTS tool. Honored only when `tools.enabled` is true. Default true.

name.description: Override the tool name. Useful for namespace-collision avoidance. The description / promptSnippet / promptGuidelines text is templated against the resolved name (v0.8.0+), so renames are reflected in the LLM-facing strings.

enabled.description: Register the STT tool. Honored only when `tools.enabled` is true. Default true.

name.description: Override the tool name. Same templating behavior as `tools.tts.name`.

tts.description: Per-extension TTS defaults. Resolution order (highest priority first): explicit JSON value > matching env var (PI_MM_TTS_*) > hardcoded default. v0.8.0+. The synthesis provider reads these once per session_start and applies them to the bridge-driven TTS path AND the LLM-callable synthesize_voice tool. The bridge's `telegram.json` `outboundHandlers[voice].defaults.{voice,lang,rate}` keys still win for the bridge-owned bridge-driven path.

voice.description: Voice ID. Replaces $PI_MM_TTS_VOICE when present in JSON. MiniMax T2A API voice ID; the full list is documented at https://platform.minimaxi.com/docs/api-reference/speech-t2a-http.

lang.description: Language boost passed to the TTS API. Replaces $PI_MM_TTS_LANG. Format is `Language,Dialect` (e.g. `Chinese,Yue` for Cantonese, `English,American` for en-US, `Chinese,Mandarin` for Mandarin).

model.description: TTS model ID. Replaces $PI_MM_TTS_MODEL. `speech-2.8-hd` is the high-def Cantonese-friendly default; older `speech-01`/`speech-02` legacy models have a 480-char per-chunk limit.

timeoutMs.description: Per-call synthesis timeout in ms. Covers both mm-tts HTTP and ffmpeg encoding. Replaces $PI_MM_TTS_VOICE_REPLY_TIMEOUT_MS. Bump if you have long text inputs and see ffmpeg timeouts.

stt.description: Per-extension STT defaults. Resolution order (highest priority first): explicit JSON value > matching env var (PI_TELEGRAM_LANG, WHISPER_SERVER_URL, PI_TELEGRAM_STT_TIMEOUT_MS) > hardcoded default. v0.8.0+. The inbound echo AND the LLM-callable transcribe_audio tool both use these defaults.

lang.description: BCP-47 / ISO-639-1 language code. Replaces $PI_TELEGRAM_LANG. whisper-server uses this as the language hint for transcription.

baseUrl.description: whisper-server base URL. Replaces $WHISPER_SERVER_URL. The container shares network_mode: host with the host, so `127.0.0.1` is the host's whisper-server from inside the container.

timeoutMs.description: Per-call STT timeout in ms. Replaces $PI_TELEGRAM_STT_TIMEOUT_MS. Bump for long voice notes on slow GPUs.
